title: The World's Biggest Desert Is Ice
hook: The largest desert on Earth is not the Sahara, it is covered in ice.
script: The largest desert on Earth is not the Sahara, it is covered in ice. It is Antarctica, a polar desert about 14 million square kilometres across. That is about one and a half times the size of the Sahara. So how dry can a frozen place really be? In parts of its Dry Valleys, it may not have rained for around two million years. Very little new snow arrives, so the ice there is ancient. What keeps storm clouds away from a continent that cold? The air is so cold that it holds almost no moisture to drop.
